note_tweet.text:
Exciting news: Muse Wonder Full (Max) by @AIatMeta has just debuted in the Code Arena: WebDev at #6 overall with 1726 pts, putting Meta in the top 3 labs!

This is +75 pts and 11 places above Muse Wonder (Max) at #17 (1651 pts), and +67 pts and 8 places above Muse Spark 1.3 (Max) at #14 (1659 pts).

Muse Wonder Full (#6) also landed +16 pts above Claude Sonnet 5.5 (#17), and +48 pts above Gemini 4 Argon (#10). With this score, Muse took the #3 lab spot (previously held by Google).

Across categories, Muse Wonder Full (Max) landed:
- #4 in Data & Analytics and in Consumer Product
- #5 in Brand & Marketing 
- #6 in Content Creation Tools
- #7 in Gaming and in Simulations
- #8 in Reference-Based Design

Congrats to the @AIatMeta team and @alexandr_wang on this release!

note_tweet.text:
if i was to work for any lab it would be meta.

as much as i love claude models, how autonomous grokbot is and the reliability of codex, its clear the world is heading towards agents working in the background as we get to spend more time doing what we love. 

community building and entertainment will be huge (it already is). creator economy is about to roadster flip over everything. meta distribution via instagram and partnering up with apple means they’re going to own a major % of the consumer end.  

mark zuckerberg recently said something in the recent cheeky pint podcast that really stuck with me. "the highest use of super intelligence is invention and creation, not automation". the more i use agents the more im realising this myself. more time to connect with loved ones, more time to work on passion projects and more time to solve harder problems. no one cares how much faster you’re flying through excel spreadsheets. or how much money you’re making. its really time to have fun. you need to dream bigger. 

thats all i’ve ever wanted to do and if progress in si stops here i would still be fully content with life. and the crazy thing is i haven’t even tried muse yet (im from uk/eu and they’re setting us back 100 years right now🥲). but i love how meta trained the model to work for personal use case in mind and this aligns with my philosophy: “more human, by design”. i see where this all heading so much clearer now. 

personal super intelligence. i dont even like saying its bigger than the internet anymore because thats obvious. truly once in a civilisation moment like alexandr said.

note_tweet.text:
Okay my Muse Wonder Full benchmark is now complete with @VulcanBench - busy weekend so might not get to put all the data and model cards together until next week.

But I wanted to share a quick peek at the combined score and how it compares to other models.

The TL;DR is, with Muse Wonder Full, Medium effort seems to be the sweet spot, but, you need to take tokens-per-task and cost-per-task into account when deciding what model to use.

In the two tables below, first is combined accuracy score, second is time per task.

Right now Muse Wonder Full is quite a bit slower than Opus 5.5, much slower than GPT-6.1 Sol, and way slower than GPT-6 Astra.

Overall, based on what I'm seeing, I would use Opus 5.5 or GPT-6.1 Sol over Muse Full at this point. You'll get the same or better accuracy faster and cheaper.

More to come in model cards and deeper analysis on the site, but it's the weekend and I'm hanging with family more than doing benchmarks so might be a day or two.

You should do the same! 🖖
